verdict.rationale: Steel is built API-first: it calls itself 'the open-source browser API for AI agents', and its documented API surfaces cover sessions, CAPTCHAs, credentials, files and agent traces. A published OpenAPI spec and an official CLI with end-to-end session control back this up, so the core capabilities are reachable programmatically. However, no source explicitly claims parity with the dashboard UI. missing for 10: explicit statement of API/UI parity, evidence that dashboard-only functions (account, API keys, billing, replay viewing) are API-accessible, independent hands-on corroboration
